title: Extra Finance announces pause in new borrowing and legacy AERO/VELO emissions cutoff
description: Extra Finance announced that new borrowing would be paused on October 14, 2026 at 08:00 UTC in preparation for the Aero upgrade. It scheduled legacy AERO and VELO emissions to end on October 22, 2026 at 00:00 UTC and advised users to close affected legacy farming positions early. The notice does not state that the whole protocol shuts down or that user assets are lost.
notes: Recorded as an announcement dated 2026-10-13 rather than a future completed-shutdown event. Follow-up required to confirm actual borrowing restrictions and October 22 effective reward cessation.
